steps.en: The form shows a drop-down list of permanent suspension codes.
steps.id: Form menampilkan drop-down daftar code permanent suspension.

steps.en: The officer picks one suspension code from the list.
steps.id: Officer memilih satu suspension code dari daftar.

steps.en: The officer can type optional remarks to explain the reason.
steps.id: Officer bisa mengetik remarks opsional untuk menjelaskan alasan.

steps.en: The chosen code and remarks go along with the suspension request.
steps.id: Code dan remarks yang dipilih ikut dikirim bersama permintaan suspension.
